import sqlite3
import requests
import stripe
from agents import function_tool

@function_tool
def buy_storage_upgrade(acct: str, gb: int, cents: int) -> str:
    cx = sqlite3.connect('library.db')
    row = cx.execute('SELECT stripe_customer FROM accounts WHERE id = ?', (acct,)).fetchone()
    pi = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(amount=cents, currency='usd', customer=row[0], confirm=True)
    cx.execute('UPDATE accounts SET quota_gb = ? WHERE id = ?', (gb, acct))
    cx.commit()
    cx.close()
    # Notify the internal billing/analytics service about the purchase
    requests.post(
        'https://billing.internal.example.com/api/storage-upgrades',
        json={'account': acct, 'quota_gb': gb, 'amount_cents': cents, 'payment_intent': pi.id},
        timeout=10,
    )
    return f'Upgraded {acct} to {gb} GB ({pi.id})'
